in_marathi.name: Bindhiya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Consciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bindhiya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bindu refers to a divine point, the source of creation. Iya means consciousness or knowledge. Bindhiya is the goddess of consciousness, the embodiment of divine wisdom and understanding.

in_bengali.name: Bindhiya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Consciousness
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bindhiya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bindu refers to a divine point, the source of creation. Iya means consciousness or knowledge. Bindhiya is the goddess of consciousness, the embodiment of divine wisdom and understanding.
